title: fix(news): retry an empty model answer with a new seed
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: News text calls now treat empty or whitespace-only model answers as failures and retry with a new seed, avoiding a cached empty response. Other retries keep the same request so they can retrieve an answer completed after a timeout. Response logging now handles null content. Tests cover a successful retry with seed 1 and returning None after three empty answers. The change applies to gist creation, per-PR Discord posts, and scheduled posts.
